state.subject: Duplicate charge on invoice #INV-2291 and export still broken
state.body: Hello, I noticed I was billed twice on 14 May for the Pro plan (two lines of $49.00 on my card statement). I already opened a ticket last week about CSV exports failing with a 500 error for workspaces over 10k rows, and nobody replied. I'm honestly considering cancelling — this is the third billing mistake this year. Please refund the duplicate charge and let me know when the export bug will be fixed. Thanks, Amara
